parsed.explanation: No traveller-facing criminalisation, facility ban, border/document friction, or police targeting is documented. Positive traveller-relevant evidence includes a prison protocol placing trans detainees by gender identity, hate-crime aggravation and anti-discrimination law, and functioning courts/police human-rights oversight credited with ending reported abuses. Two dated violent incidents (2021 beating, 2023 murder with confession) in the capital are isolated, not a documented pattern or state campaign, and barely move the rating. Self-ID, marriage and public care are resident-facing climate signals only. Stalled/regressive legislation in 2024-25 has not enacted a traveller restriction. Residual uncertainty on everyday visitor-setting discrimination keeps it below the strongest 0.85-0.95 profiles.
